sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description:
The name of the filter condition.

Valid values:

- StartTime

- EndTime

- ApplicationGroupName

- ResourceName

- EventName

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The values for the filter condition. You can specify up to 10 values.

parameters.name: LogSource
parameters.description:
The source of the logs. Valid values:

- application: Logs from the application.

- computeNest: Logs from Compute Nest.

- ros: Logs from Resource Orchestration Service (ROS).

parameters.name: Logstore
parameters.description: The name of the Simple Log Service Logstore.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that specifies the next page of results to return. Set this parameter to the NextToken value from a previous response to retrieve the next page of results.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- **Ascending**: Ascending order.

- **Descending** (default): Descending order.
